title: Modular Web-Based CRM System
Sales Module Development
tools: Visual Studio Code, Supabase, GitHub, Figma
background: This capstone project, titled "Design and Implementation of a Modular Web-Based CRM System Using API-Driven Architecture," focused on developing a modular CRM system to support and streamline core business processes through an integrated, API-driven system. I was primarily responsible for the Sales Module, covering the end-to-end sales workflow from lead assignment to performance monitoring.
teamNote: Officially defended on 29 July 2026 at President University, marking the completion of my undergraduate Capstone Project in Information Systems.
contributions: Developed lead assignment features for Sales Managers, including assigning, reassigning, and returning leads.
Built opportunity, visit, and follow-up tracking features to help Sales Staff record and monitor their sales activities.
Recorded deal outcomes such as Won and Lost statuses to support accurate sales progress tracking and reporting.
Built performance monitoring and next-month forecast for individual Sales Staff and team-wide oversight.
